Fourteen teams contested the 1999–2000 edition of the league. The first team in the league, [[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]], were crowned the champions, and qualified for the first round of the [[2000 CAF Champions League|CAF Champions League]] in 2000 along with the team finishing in second place. Third placed team qualified to confederation cup. Finally, the last three in the league will play next season in the second division.
